blocks.content: Here's a step-by-step guide you can follow to build a minimum spanning tree using Prim's algorithm:
1. Start with the lowest-cost edge and add it to the minimum spanning tree.
2. Move to the next lowest-cost edge. Add it to the tree only if

items: It is connected to an existing vertex in the tree.

blocks.content: 3. Repeat the steps until you scan all the edges in the graph.
Now, we will find the lowest spanning tree of the given graph using the same thought process.
